name: Shift Closer
description: Scheduled Cloud Run Function that logs out of work platforms and emails an end-of-shift summary. Credentials via Secret Manager, not .env.
notes: First build of a separate 60-build GCP-focused list. Platform integration is mocked (no real target platform) -- Secret Manager, Cloud Scheduler, and Cloud Run Function architecture are real. Not yet deployed.

name: Web Scraper Bot
description: Cloud Run service that checks real estate listing prices daily and texts you when one drops below threshold. Credentials via Secret Manager, not .env.
notes: Second build in the GCP 60-build list. Listing scrape is mocked (no real target site yet) -- Firestore price tracking, Secret Manager, Twilio SMS, and the new-crossing-only detection logic are real. Not yet deployed.

name: Discord Webhook Alerter
description: Monitors your HTTP endpoints on a schedule and posts a Discord alert when one goes down. Go, Cloud Run Functions, Cloud Tasks fan-out with OIDC auth.
notes: Third build in the GCP 60-build list, first in Go. Two functions: Dispatch (Scheduler-triggered) fans out one Cloud Task per endpoint to Check (Cloud Tasks-triggered), giving per-endpoint retry independent of the others. The health check itself is real, not mocked. Not yet deployed.

name: Automated Report Dispatcher
description: Compiles monthly order stats into a PDF and emails it to stakeholders. Python, Cloud Run, SendGrid API, real PDF + email, mocked data source.
notes: Fourth build in the GCP 60-build list. Only the underlying order database is mocked -- stats aggregation, PDF generation (reportlab), and email sending (SendGrid) are all real. Not yet deployed.

name: TikTok Auto-Poster
description: Pulls drafted videos from a Firestore queue and posts them to TikTok's real Content Posting API, on a schedule you set. Node.js, Cloud Run Functions, Cloud Tasks fan-out.
notes: Fifth build in the GCP 60-build list, scoped to TikTok specifically (real personal use case) instead of the original generic "social APIs" spec. Dispatch/Publish split like build #3; the TikTok API call itself is real code against TikTok's real Content Posting API, not mocked. Not yet deployed.
